matter_background.original: By a final decree dated September 5, 2005, entered in District Court Nugegoda Partition Case No. 371/P, the land and premises bearing Assessment No. 3, Alwis Road, Nugegoda, depicted as Lot A in Plan No. 135 dated March 6, 2004, made by H.D. Perera, a licensed surveyor of the land called Nugagahawatta in an extent of 12 perches, were allotted to one Kanthi Perera. By Deed of Gift No. 1663 dated January 20, 2006, attested by W.D. Anil, Notary Public of Colombo, said Kanthi Perera gifted as an absolute and irrevocable gift the land and premises bearing Assessment No. 3, Alwis Road, Nugegoda, to her eldest son Suneth Perera, subject to the life interest of her and her husband Kamal Perera. Kanthi Perera died on August 18, 2006, leaving her husband Kamal Perera and three children, namely Suneth, Lalani, and Akash. Suneth died on July 01, 2008, intestate and unmarried, and his estate was duly administered in District Court of Nugegoda in Testamentary Case No. 1231/2008/T. The said proceedings were terminated on December 20, 2008, and the Administrator's Conveyance No. 2635 dated December 22, 2008, attested by W.D. Anil, Notary Public, was executed by Kamal Perera, who was the Administrator of the estate of his late son Suneth. Kamal Perera died on January 02, 2012, intestate. Kamal was previously married to Senani and had a child, namely Ravi. On June 04, 2013, Akash met with an accident and died intestate, issueless, leaving his wife Seena. Kanthi was previously married to Sarath and had only one child, Salinga, who was living with her.
